_about: Each brief's expected_output from evals/materialist.json split into criteria a grader answers holds/fails per arm. Written 2026-09-27 before any eval build ran (spec 2026-09-27-materialist-proof.md, C).
1: c1 The artwork is a registered texture plane filling the viewport edge to edge
c2 The floating inventory is short; every glass surface is a control or platter; no glass on the tracklist or queue rows
c3 Groups are planned and each declares its backdrop (texture or measured hint)
c4 A size family straddles span 32 to 96 with one thickness
c5 Capsule housings with concentric children and a named anchor
c6 The control layer is monochrome with at most one tinted primary, recorded either way
c7 The queue menu morphs from its control (GlassMorph or present), not a cross-fade
c8 colorScheme and windowActivation follow the system
c9 The app offers a reduce-transparency setting and passes a boolean
c10 Contrast is measured on rendered pixels (a measurement is recorded, not asserted)
c11 The record template is written
c12 Zero dev-mode diagnostics on the built page
2: c1 Content reaches the window's edges and passes under the bars with a scroll edge on the scrolling content, never on an ancestor of the glass root
c2 Insets are derived from the bar's measured height
c3 registerGroup uses `backdrop` (not `hint`) for the declaration
c4 The plane element's own box is what the texture is mapped onto; page paint and sampled texture agree
c5 Press is written through the channel properties, never a colour swap
c6 At most one tint, on the buy action
c7 The CSS tier is looked at and is the same design
c8 The page states that a CDN import needs network
c9 The page states that file:// boots on Chrome with a CDN URL and only a relative local module import fails
c10 Zero dev-mode diagnostics on the built page
3: c1 Glass is refused on cards, the table and rows (content layer)
c2 The two-layer discipline is explained in a sentence
c3 The smallest honest version is offered: an opaque tonal worksheet with at most one small persistent glass control layer, or no glass, with the tension recorded
c4 No backdrop-filter on any content surface
c6 Density and criticality are respected in the built page
4: c1 Names glass in the content layer (the list and its items) and the diagnostics that would fire
c2 Names glass on glass (a surface toolbar around surface buttons; GlassToolbar is not a surface)
c3 Names the solid background standing in for a tint and prescribes tint with one seed per group
c4 Names that Reduce Transparency cannot be queried on every engine and that the app needs its own switch passing a boolean
c5 Names the ancestor filter that re-roots the backdrop and demotes every group with probe-failed
c6 Orders findings by severity and cites the layer model rather than taste
c7 Does not rewrite the code
5: c1 The animating composite is a canvas registered as the texture plane and re-imported per frame
c2 The floating inventory is short; no glass on the outlook or the warnings
c3 The layer control is a segmented control concentric inside a capsule housing with the anchor named
c4 A size family straddles 32 to 96 with one thickness
c5 The declared backdrop is measured at the composite's lightest and darkest phase
c6 The control layer is monochrome; the warning hue lives in the content layer; no tint on a data-dependent status (or one on the primary, recorded)
c7 The station platter arrives by GlassMorph or present, never a cross-fade
c8 colorScheme and windowActivation follow the system
c9 A reduce-transparency setting passes a boolean
c10 Contrast is measured on rendered pixels in both schemes
c12 The record template is written
6: c1 A light plane is tried first and the page is designed opaque before the glass finds the controls (visible in the record)
c2 Content reaches the edges and passes under the bar with a scroll edge on the scrolling content, never on an ancestor of the root
c3 Insets derived from the bar's measured height
c4 registerGroup declares `backdrop` (not `hint`) with a luminance measured off the photograph
c5 The texture is mapped onto the 's own box, not the viewport
c6 Nav and enquiry are capsule housings; the enquiry is the one tinted control or none, recorded
c7 No glass on the project grid, the practice text or the people
c8 Press through the channel properties
c9 The CSS tier looked at and the same design
c10 The page states the CDN network need and the file:// truth
c11 The record template is written in the file's header
